bundle.shortDescription: Pack a repo into AI-ready XML with a validated planner→executor protocol
bundle.longDescription: ProjectPacker turns a folder or GitHub repo into a single self-describing XML file optimized for a two-AI workflow: any web AI plans, any coding agent executes, and ProjectPacker validates the handoff between them.
